note:
Drafted from Psalms 32–33 audit. The city Resen (Gen 10:12), formerly a second word here, is now names/raesaen; the relationship between the two words is unknown.

Root (2026-11-21): Aramaic רִסְנָא “bridle, reins” (Jastrow, T00858) has the same three consonants and no verbal derivation is attested in scripture, so the noun keeps its own consonants.
summary: רֶסֶן is a rein or bridle by which an animal is directed (Psa 32:9).

senses.definition: A rein or bridle used to guide an animal.
